articles.title: Data Quality Is the Foundation of Post-Trade Automation
articles.summary: The next stage of post-trade automation will depend as much on data quality as on advances in technology. Artificial intelligence (AI) can help firms identify anomalies, resolve exceptions and streamline workflows, but these capabilities rely on accurate, consistent and well-governed data.
